# Vela

Vela is a voice-to-quote app. Record a voice note on site and Vela turns it into a professional quote you can share by WhatsApp or email. SMS is not live yet.

Who it's for: electricians, plumbers and handymen, and other owner-operators who quote on site.

Status: pre-launch waitlist. Vela is not live yet. Join the early-access waitlist and Vela will email when it is ready to try.

https://www.velaquote.com
https://www.velaquote.com/voice-to-quote-electricians
https://www.velaquote.com/#waitlist
